plans.name: PowerFIX 24
plans.notes: Fact sheet (same version as last week) and plans page (26 Oct) agree; unchanged. Terms: the fact sheet says customers without an SP Services account pay 65% of SP's deposit; our wording says only that there is no separate deposit.
plans.evidence: Fixed rate plan: Duration Rates (before GST) Rates (after GST) 24 month/s 28.35 cents/kWh 30.90 cents/kWh

terms.deposit_source: Security Deposit (see footnote 7): Security Deposit (“SD”) shall be collected and retained on behalf of Retailer by SP Services Limited (“SP”). Existing SP’s customers will not be required to provide additional SD. Non-existing SP’s customers will be required to provide a SD equivalent to 65% of the SD as determined and published by SP.
terms.deposit: None if you already have an SP Services account. Otherwise you pay a deposit of 65% of the amount SP Services sets, collected by SP Services.
